_comment: sim-robust-movegroup-reattach-after-respawn-v1 bounded GPU proof (hand-off to the integration lane, twin-robot-in-store-boot-v1). Purpose: prove the carton RE-ATTACH now SUCCEEDS on a respawned move_group, closing the one recovery step respawn2 showed never worked. Root cause (respawn2 host-stack.log 7271+): object_attachment runs in a SEPARATE container (component_container_mt-2) that does NOT die with the SIGABRT-killed move_group-1, so after the launch respawn it STILL holds restock_carried_unit and refuses the re-attach's bare ADD -> '[restock_sim.object_attachment]: Object already attached. Detach first before attaching a new object.' -> PAYLOAD_SYNC_DIAG gate=attach_goal_rejected repeated for the whole 30 s budget -> PR 242 gap-1 fast-fail at lift. The fix RECONCILES that surviving attach on the post-respawn re-attach (detach-first, then re-ADD) and surfaces the reason by name; it is ALWAYS-ON + SELF-DISABLING (runs only on a crash-retry resend) so there is NO new mission config key and a no-respawn run is byte-identical. The integration lane holds the GPU and schedules both runs through flock /tmp/aile-gpu.lock, never forced, never touching the whispr service (pid 1339, ~2.2 GB); do NOT edit the ~/datasets runtime configs from a worker PR -- this fragment is the hand-off.
_no_new_config_key: There is NO key to merge. The reconcile re-attach + the world-obstacle resync live in the client recovery path (scripts/twin/restock_manipulation/ros_adapter.py _resync_scene_after_respawn/_reattach_payload and ros_payload.py __call__ reconcile=/_reconcile_detach/resync_world_after_respawn). They engage only on a move_group crash-retry resend, so a healthy run never touches them. The ONLY config these runs need is the existing HOST movegroup_respawn block + the validator's own death injector (both unchanged from respawn2).
_movegroup_respawn_note: Unchanged from respawn2 (HOST block, scripts/twin/restock_host/config.py / launch.py / movegroup_respawn.py). max_retries=2 => two lifetime respawns are allowed before the supervisor gives up by name.

_run_A_double_death_recovers._setup: The respawn2 configuration UNCHANGED (head: this PR merged into fm/twin-robot-in-store-boot-v1): collect-only, FRESH commission, HOST movegroup_respawn={max_retries:2, delay:3.0}, the v3 double-death injector killing move_group with kill -ABRT twice -- the first AFTER the carton attach (as respawn2), the second after the first recovery completes.
_run_A_double_death_recovers._command: scripts/run_restock_render_smoke.py ... (the validator's collect-only mission boot used for respawn2) -- same runner, same guards (env_isaaclab python, the task-local nvidia userspace, flock /tmp/aile-gpu.lock, --heavy-threshold-mb 2500 for whispr), never --force.
_run_A_double_death_recovers._pass_criteria: PASS = after EACH of the two deaths the re-attach SUCCEEDS within the 30 s sim budget and collect COMPLETES with the carton on the rollwagen. The console shows, per death: 'MOVE_GROUP_RESPAWN move_group died pid=... exit=-6; relaunching move_group (attempt 1/2 ...)' then '... (attempt 2/2 ...)', and for each re-attach a NEW 'PAYLOAD_SYNC_DIAG gate=reconcile_detach_ok (surviving object_attachment attach cleared before re-ADD)' followed by 'MOVE_GROUP_CRASH_RETRY re-attached restock_carried_unit to the respawned move_group planning scene before resend'. FAIL = any of: 'PAYLOAD_SYNC_DIAG gate=attach_goal_rejected ...' repeated to the budget end, the gap-1 named fast-fail 'MOVE_GROUP_CRASH_RETRY re-attach ... NEVER SUCCEEDED within 30s sim', or 'arm command heartbeat lost' / any carton-less resend ('will plan WITHOUT it' must remain grep=0).
_run_A_double_death_recovers._what_changed_vs_respawn2: respawn2 (pre-fix) showed 'Object already attached' + gate=attach_goal_rejected for the whole budget then the gap-1 fast-fail. This run must instead show the reconcile_detach_ok line clearing the surviving attach, the re-attach succeeding, and collect finishing.

_run_B_triple_death_gives_up_by_name._setup: Identical to run A but the v3 injector kills move_group a THIRD time (after the second recovery). movegroup_respawn stays {max_retries:2}.
_run_B_triple_death_gives_up_by_name._pass_criteria: PASS = the first two deaths recover exactly as run A (reconcile_detach_ok, attempts 1/2 then 2/2), and the THIRD death EXCEEDS max_retries so the respawn supervisor GIVES UP BY NAME (PR 247: the bounded-respawn give-up log naming the retry count) and the stage FAILS FAST (PR 234/242 backstop) rather than hanging. FAIL = a 3rd respawn is attempted, the run hangs, or it fails with an opaque (non-respawn-named) reason.
_run_B_triple_death_gives_up_by_name._scope_note: This run only confirms the fix did NOT weaken the PR 247 bounded-respawn give-up or the PR 234/242 fast-fail backstop (both out of scope to change here, in scope to keep intact).

_activation_check: No HOST_EFFECTIVE_CONFIG key to grep (no new key). Confirm the fix path is reached by the reconcile_detach_* PAYLOAD_SYNC_DIAG line on the first post-respawn re-attach; its absence on a no-death (healthy) run confirms self-disabling / byte-identical.
_cpu_proof: env -u PYTHONPATH PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1 python3 -m pytest scripts/twin/tests/test_restock_detach_ack.py scripts/twin/tests/test_ros_adapter_branch.py scripts/twin/tests/test_movegroup_respawn.py -- the reconcile re-attach clears a surviving object_attachment attach then resends; the rejection reason is surfaced by name (reattach_reject_gate); first-start and post-respawn produce the same scene (scene_bootstrap_ops); the world-obstacle resync re-establishes the static scene and tolerates a raise; the no-respawn path never passes reconcile (byte-identical).
